text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eek! T-Trainer?! I-I-I guess I was just
reminiscing
on some memories...
choice_data_list: おはよう、鼻歌なんて珍しいな
おはよう、鼻歌なんて珍しいね
choice_data_list_en: Good morning. Rare to hear you humming.
Good morning. Rare to hear you humming.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You see, I happened to bump into
Opera O at the
park yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And wouldn't you know? I was granted a front-row seat to her performance, The Opera Overlord: Five-Hour Edition!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Reminiscing on that wonderful voice of
hers
brings me courage. I'll probably get
through
today without making a single
mistake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she had herself an exciting
day off!
